(1) the distribution of binaural tuning curves is predicted by a Hebbian model of development; (2) this model predicts that binaural tuning depends on the frequency selectivity of the basilar membrane and the distribution of axonal delays in the auditory pathway; (3) the model is consistent with recent observations of best delay tuning that is dependent on preferred frequency; and (4) the model predicts that the best delays are not the axonal delays, but the axonal delays
